race.description: Tab Qtis 3yo Colts & Geldings Mdn Plate
race.comment: SIBI IPSE FORTUNAE (11) is worth following up after a nice debut effort at Eagle Farm over this trip. Is sure to have come on from that and can take the next step. PLAN OF ATTACK (9) is the obvious danger after missing narrowly in both runs back this campaign. Should be nearing his top now and has shown enough early dash to offset the wide draw. MEAN KING (6) returns after making a promising start in the Winter. The form around him looks good and two trials should have him forward. FLAVOUROFTHEMONTH (3) makes his debut for the Gollan camp and gets a key booking in Maloney from a nice draw. Strips fitter for two solid trials and can make his presence felt.
